text.text:
We went there for dinner on a Sunday evening and I would recommend to make a reservation in advance.

They welcomed us very nicely and after they took our coats and gave us a number for picking up later, the waiter brought us to our table. As the picture shows we got seated in that super nice artistic room. Nearby the entrance are also other rooms but not designed in that artistic style. I would recommend to make a reservation if you want to get seated there.

We ordered two starters and shared one main and one dessert. The signature carpaccio was really nice but the new style crudo was nothing special in taste. I wouldn’t order the new style crudo again. The Chateaubriand 600g for two was nice and tender, we ordered medium rare. Unfortunately the main always comes with mashed potato and we wanted to change even if they gonna charge us more, but here the restaurant wasn’t flexible at all, although they’re more on the pricey side. Really sad. As side we added jalapeños peppers and the paradise pepper sauce, the waiter recommended to us. Meat quality was on point and also the sauce fit perfectly. Jalapeños peppers were normal. For dessert we ordered the signature chocolate soufflé and it goes really well with the two scoops ice cream (I think it was ginger).

All in all, a nice restaurant with cozy ambience, friendly waiters and good quality meat, which is more on the pricey side. The drinks were average, the music not too loud and we had a nice evening. The only thing I would appreciate, if they could be more flexible by changing the side dish for the main and also I would recommend to change the disposable chopsticks to more high quality ones. This kinda ruin the table situation if you have nice cutlery and even individualized plates with cute emojis.

text.text:
Short summary:
Where Beefbar stands out is the artistic interieur style while creating a cozy atmosphere as well. It’s a great place for special occasions, but also easy to go to any time.

Welcome, first impression & service:
We received a friendly welcome and were greeted by the waiters when being brought to our table. The plates with individual Emojis imprinted are a felicitous change and can even be bought in their online shop. Important: The restaurant has different rooms and not each of them has this artistic style as shown on the picture. I assume the earlier you book a reservation, the better the chances to be in that room. The service was very friendly and attentive for the whole night. Also, we never had to wait long for what we ordered.

The food:
As a starter we had Rock Corn (corn in tempura with spicy mayonnaise) and Mini Big K (Mini Kobe beef bacon burgers & sauces). While the Rock Corn is definitely to recommend, the Mini Big K was not special. You do not really taste the Kobe beef and the sauces are the same for each of the 3 mini burgers.
As a main I had the Terroir Filet, 200g with Fries, jalapeños peppers and the Paradise Pepper Sauce (Sarawak black pepper, pink peppercorn, yellow mustard). Simply said, on point. Medium rare to the point, high quality meat, delicious sides and a tasty sauce. I would order this combination again. Nothing to complain on what I ordered.

Worth to mention:
At first, I wanted to order the Coeur d‘Entrecôte from the menu’s Grilled section with Parmesan & Summer Truffle Fries. I was told that’s not possible. All the meat from the Grilled section comes with the Homemade Potato Mash always. This is nowhere mentioned on the menu and is also something I do not understand why it should not be possible. But, there was no way around it. In the end I chose something different which was delicious in the end, but also cheaper for me or also said less profitable for the restaurant. In that regards, I would expect more flexibility or a better explanation why I must take the potato mash.

editorialSummary.text: Generous steaks & burgers served in a laid-back restaurant also offering wine, cocktails & desserts.

text.text: This burger was probably one of the best burgers I’ve ever had. The beef was just an okay quality, but it was really well cooked. I had Orangina for the first time, and it’s certainly one of the better orange soft drinks. The servers were friendly and easy to chat with despite the language barriers. The restaurant was really nicely lit and organized, but the bathroom was in need of a repair.

text.text:
My husband and I took our daughter to this restaurant while we were visiting Paris and thought it was so good we returned just 2 days later.
The atmosphere is vibrant and all staff are extremely attentive. For a busy restaurant you do not feel pushed out the door as soon as you have eaten, you can stay and chat with a drink after your meal if you choose.
We had the Franklin Burger which was delicious!! There is a vast selection of food choices to meet all tastes, my daughter chose a salad which looked great!!
The prices are extremely affordable which can be proven by the number of locals who eat at the restaurant, €20 got us a main and dessert and for €9 I got a cocktail drink which is standard cost.
We would certainly recommend Franklin and may even make a third visit while visiting Paris.

text.text:
We ordered the 1KG Prime Rib with Fries and Sauce Bernaise and we ordered the meat medium.
The meat came fast and it was chopped like dog food. There was absolutely no seasoning on the meat and the meat did not get any rest so the juices of the meat were running all over the plate and it was more of a fried steak bathed in oil than anything else, while eating the meat you could feel the oil in your mouth.
It was the first time in my life I ate rare, medium rare, medium , medium well and well done all in one steak. I don't know how they did it but it was an amazing experience. I'm a Chef and I honestly couldn't understand how this was even possible. I gave you this star only because you surprised me with this steak. The sauce Bernaise reminded me of more of a dressing than a sauce because of the amount of vinegar in it. And the fries reminded me of the worst quality fries you could have bought from Lidl.
A high amount of the steak was thrown out but we were still hungry. Due to us still beeing hungry  after this visit we went to eat streetfood which was ten times  better and a third of the price.
If you have €100 to through out it's a good choice but if not, this place is not recommended.

We had an amazing dining experience! The meat was absolutely delicious, especially the Argentinian rib-eye, which was incredibly tender and flavorful. The staff were warm, friendly, and attentive, making us feel right at home.

For the quality of food, the prices are very reasonable—comparable to similar restaurants we frequent in Barcelona. The restaurant’s atmosphere is elegant and sophisticated, with a beautifully designed interior that enhances the entire experience.

Highly recommended for a memorable meal!
